1. Enhance the Edit Stock (Stock Correction) process to manage both roll-level and OC-level reservations when a correction is initiated and sent for approval.
2. At the time of Edit Stock submission (Waiting / Approval Pending status):
3. Freeze the entire roll associated with the stock correction, consistent with existing system behavior.
4. In addition to roll freeze, identify all OCs to which the roll is currently allocated.
5. Freeze the OC-level reserved quantities corresponding to that roll so that these quantities are not considered available for any downstream transactions.

chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: … › Purpose
chunks.text:
Currently, when a stock correction (Edit Stock) is initiated for a roll that is allocated across multiple OCs, the system freezes the entire roll quantity but does not freeze the OC-level reserved quantities. This results in inconsistencies where stock appears available at the OC level but cannot be physically used due to the roll being frozen.
The purpose of this enhancement is to ensure that both the roll and the corresponding OC-level quantities are frozen during stock correction and correctly reconciled once the correction is approved.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: … › Business Requirement
chunks.text:
When a roll is allocated across multiple OCs and a stock correction is submitted for approval, the system currently cannot determine from which OC the quantity should be unreserved. To handle this, the system freezes the full roll quantity but continues to show OC-level quantities as available for transactions such as GDI.
This creates operational issues where picklists fail due to roll unavailability, despite OC quantities appearing available. The business requires a solution where OC-level quantities are also frozen during stock correction, preventing further transactions until approval is completed.

• In addition to roll freeze, identify all OCs to which the roll is currently allocated.
• Freeze the OC-level reserved quantities corresponding to that roll so that these quantities are not considered available for any downstream transactions.
• Ensure frozen OC quantities are excluded from availability calculations for:
• GDI
• Picklist creation
• Split Roll
• Re-QC
• Edit Stock

• Stock does not appear available at OC level for further allocation.
• System does not allow transactions that would fail later due to roll unavailability.

• OC selected in the Edit Stock transaction
